messages:
maya_release: Starting rollout for release 2026.03.14 (v1.12.0) — plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Canary in each region at 5%, then 25% -> 100%.

alex_dev: change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Confirmed.

deploy-bot: [automated] canary created: v1.12.0 -> us-east-1, 5% traffic. ID: canary-1812349200-01

priya_ops: quick capacity check in us-east-1: serving nodes 12, avg GPU util 58%, p95 latency 134ms. OK to proceed.

josh_platform: pinned model bundle 'redwood-open-1.2-quant' on dedicated pool us-east-1-dedicated as part of rollout config.

maya_release: rules: if p95 latency > 220ms for 5m OR error rate > 1% for 3m -> auto rollback to v1.11.9. Also manual rollback allowed.

liam_oncall: I'll watch dashboards and canary traces. Paging policy enabled. @maya_release add me to the oncall rotation for this window.

deploy-bot: traffic ramp: canary-1812349200-01 -> 25% at +10m; roll to 100% at +40m if health ok.

priya_ops: ran smoke load: qps spike sim to 2x baseline; cache hit 72%, memory headroom 18%. No OOMs seen.

alex_dev: EU prep: canary will start in eu-west-1 after US reaches steady 25% for 15m. APAC scheduled last to avoid midnight local spikes.

maya_release: release notes posted to #announcements and GH release. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/v1.12.0

josh_platform: small tweak: set batching max_tokens=1024 in us-east to reduce latency tail.

deploy-bot: canary health OK — p50 72ms p95 150ms errrate 0.2% cpu 44% gpu 61% :thumbsup:

liam_oncall: :eyes: will escalate if p95 trends upward. keeping oncall slack open.

maya_release: thanks everyone. If we hit rollback conditions we revert and open a postmortem. Good luck :rocket:
